disease: Primary (systemic) carnitine deficiency (carnitine transporter OCTN2 deficiency)

emergence.disease: Primary (systemic) carnitine deficiency (carnitine transporter OCTN2 deficiency)
emergence.summary: An autosomal-recessive fatty-acid-oxidation disorder caused by loss-of-function mutations in SLC22A5, which encodes OCTN2 (chr5q31.1) -- the high-affinity, sodium-dependent carnitine transporter that actively DRIVES carnitine into heart, skeletal-muscle, kidney and other cells, and reabsorbs filtered carnitine in the renal tubule. Carnitine is required to shuttle long-chain fatty acids across the inner mitochondrial membrane for beta-oxidation, the main energy source for heart and muscle during fasting. When OCTN2 fails, carnitine is wasted in the urine, plasma and tissue carnitine fall sharply, and long-chain fatty-acid oxidation collapses -- presenting as hypoketotic hypoglycaemia and hepatic encephalopathy in infants, hypertrophic / dilated cardiomyopathy and skeletal myopathy in children, and arrhythmia, fatigue or sudden death later. The kit reads this as the intracellular-carnitine-availability / long-chain-fatty-acid-oxidation-flux axis driven DOWN (an active importer / accelerator LOF -> the drive that loads cellular carnitine is lost -> the downstream pathway is under-supplied). Correction is a REPLACE by mass action: high-dose oral levocarnitine (L-carnitine; Carnitor, FDA-approved for primary and secondary carnitine deficiency) floods the system to restore intracellular and tissue carnitine through residual / low-affinity uptake, re-enabling fatty-acid oxidation. This is a once-lethal disease made survivable: started early, levocarnitine REVERSES the cardiomyopathy, myopathy and hypoglycaemic episodes; affected individuals are lifelong dependent on supplementation. IMPORTANT HONESTY: the corrective DIRECTION (replace the missing substrate) is forced [F]; the realised MAGNITUDE is [O] and TIMING-limited (reversal is documented when treatment precedes irreversible organ damage), and the dose is [O] (a clinical / runtime quantity, never sequence-derived). The SLC22A5 coding lesions (and a frequent 5'-UTR uORF-creating variant) sit outside the promoter firewall; the gamma read is of the SLC22A5 promoter switch STRUCTURE (chr5, gamma 1.3724). Magnitude [O].
emergence.emergent_axis: intracellular carnitine availability / long-chain fatty-acid beta-oxidation flux -- OCTN2 (SLC22A5) actively imports carnitine into heart/muscle/kidney cells and reabsorbs it in the renal tubule. LOF wastes carnitine in the urine and depletes cellular carnitine, so long-chain fatty-acid import into mitochondria fails (axis DOWN; hypoketotic hypoglycaemia, cardiomyopathy, myopathy). An active-importer LOF whose corrective is to flood the missing substrate

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: SLC22A5 encodes OCTN2, the high-affinity Na+-dependent organic cation / carnitine transporter that actively DRIVES cellular carnitine uptake and renal carnitine reabsorption -- an active import 'drive'. LOF wastes carnitine in urine and depletes tissue carnitine, collapsing long-chain fatty-acid oxidation. chr5q31.1. autosomal recessive. NCBI official symbol SLC22A5. OMIM 212140.

falsifiers.claim: SLC22A5 LOF moves the cellular-carnitine / fatty-acid-oxidation axis DOWN (the active carnitine importer / renal reabsorber is lost)
falsifiers.falsifier: an SLC22A5 loss-of-function allele that RAISED plasma / tissue carnitine or preserved long-chain fatty-acid oxidation would refute the import-drive-lost (axis DOWN) read
falsifiers.measurable_by: plasma free carnitine, fibroblast carnitine-transport assay (<10% of control), and fatty-acid-oxidation flux in SLC22A5-deficient cells / patients

falsifiers.claim: REPLACING carnitine (levocarnitine) is the CORRECTIVE direction
falsifiers.falsifier: if high-dose levocarnitine failed to raise tissue carnitine / failed to improve fatty-acid oxidation or cardiomyopathy in OCTN2 deficiency, the replace lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: plasma/tissue carnitine, echocardiographic cardiomyopathy and metabolic decompensation on levocarnitine in primary carnitine deficiency
